title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Every position in this record is paper. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. One trade does not say anything about a strategy. The engines' own state is read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now. The figures below are the live paper record as read at 2026-11-13T15:04:11.852Z, and the same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## Open positions

htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper and 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v006 has 0 positions open on paper. NEAR entered at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close, but that position is no longer open because ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close at 1.703. The open NEAR position and the closed ATOM position are the only trade-level facts in this snapshot; everything else in the engines is flat on paper. Live starts are v005 from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026, so the record is short and the sample of closed trades is small.

## Closed trades

ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. trend-daily-v005 has 6 closed trades so far, with an average −13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 7 closed trades so far, with an average −13.34% net per trade. htf-rsi-v007 has 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade. In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. A single closed trade, including the ATOM loss of −17.9%, does not establish anything about the strategy; the record is too small and every figure is paper. The closed-trade averages are measurements of what happened in this short live window, not claims about what will happen next.

## Market filter and breakout distance

trend-daily-v005: the Bitcoin market filter is off. trend-daily-v006: the Bitcoin market filter is off. Both engines show 0 positions open on paper. The closest names to a 20-day breakout are AVAXUSDT at 7.69% below its high, TRXUSDT at 10.39% below its high, and BNBUSDT at 13.54% below its high for trend-daily-v005; for trend-daily-v006 the same AVAXUSDT and TRXUSDT distances are 7.69% and 10.39%, with JUPUSDT at 11.47% below its high. The filter being off and the flat position count are the current state read from the record; they are not a forecast of when entries will occur. The breakout distances are measurements from the current market level to the stated high, and they describe how far each name is from triggering the rule; they do not say whether the rule will trigger.

## Rules and measurements

The record shows a rule, a measurement, and an outcome for the closed ATOM trade: entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close, exit below the 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close at 1.703, and a result of −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The open NEAR position follows a separate entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 and has no recorded exit in this snapshot. The trend engines show market-filter state and breakout distance rather than open positions: the Bitcoin market filter is off for both, and the nearest distances are 7.69%, 10.39%, 11.47%, and 13.54%. The measurement for htf-rsi-v007 is 4 closed trades with an average null net per trade. These pairings describe what the rules produced in this window; they do not project the next trade.

## Reading the record

The record updates continuously. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-13T15:04:11.852Z. Every figure in this article is paper, limited to the live record, and inconclusive on its own. Paper means no capital is at risk in this record; the measurements describe signal outcomes only. Nothing here is advice, and nothing here predicts a future price or a future trade.
